Cost-schedule honesty item: the 0.75-1.0bp initiate / 0.3-0.4bp hedge-roll one-way schedule is a USD 2019 Citi measurement APPLIED CROSS-MARKET as an assumption; every graded verdict carries {0,1,2}x multipliers and the break-even cost curve. PRE-REGISTERED (before any conditional number exists). H13 grail-conditional entries: on the 18 registered Citi pairs (USD 9 / EUR 3 / JPY 3 / GBP 2 / CAD 1), state = repriced flattener carry >= 0 AND gamma_25 > 0 (the Citi Mar-2020 free-convexity definition, NO threshold sweep). Episodes bridge <=3-day gaps. Entry lag-1 at state onset, $100k DV01, 25bp resize trigger, annual roll; exit on state exit or 126bd cap. Costs: 0.75/1.0bp initiate + 0.3/0.4bp hedge-roll one-way, x{0,1,2}. Control: unconditional always-on flattener, same pair, same engine, same sample. FALSIFIED IF grail entries indistinguishable from unconditional on net + distribution, or occupancy/episode-length makes initiation unpayable (oracle gate prong a). Trial counting: one trial per pair whose conditional result is examined; cost multipliers are sensitivity, not selection.

H15 aging decay MEASURED (descriptive, USD, 6 inceptions 2006-2021 x 3 pairs x {1,2,3,5}y): median gamma retention at 3y = 1.30-1.35x inception, at 5y = 1.57-1.70x; long-leg DV01 similar. The PM back-book claim (multi-year holds retain exposure) SURVIVES; the 'convexity decays fast' falsification does NOT fire. CONFOUND noted: fractions mix pure aging with rate-LEVEL paths (falling rates raise receiver DV01/gamma); a curve-held-fixed aging-only measure is the refinement for the findings doc. h15_aging_USD.parquet.

FIXED the QDB direction-blind signed-bpv seam (kink-fade v2 §6, reported 2026-07-30, unfixed until now). Root cause: RLIRSwapCurve.resolve_pricable signed the ALREADY-SIGNED rateslib notional by risk_weight (QL mirror semantics assume unsigned notional), so receiver(-N, rw-1) resolved to payer(+N). Verified live pre-fix: bpv=+/-100k both printed +$2,303,346 on the 2022-09 CPI week (+23.4bp); post-fix they mirror exactly and the payer gains in the selloff. Fix: abs() before signing (QL semantics). Pinned by tests/test_rlirswap_resolve_direction.py (4 tests incl the QL-convention unsigned caller); blast-radius subset 161 passed / 0 failed. Certification landmine 1 CLEARED in-session on this tree.

H15 refined with the curve-held-fixed measure (rl.Curve.roll k years, same shape): PURE-AGING gamma retention 1.010-1.055x out to 5y on all three pairs - aging alone neither decays nor grows the convexity; the market-curve fractions (1.3-1.7x) were rate-level path effects. H15 verdict: NOT falsified - multi-year back-book holds retain their convexity exposure (the PM 'in 3 years that's still 7y10y' claim), cleanly measured. h15_aging_USD.parquet (144 rows, measure={market_curve,pure_aging}).

H14 gate SMOKE (79 evals, 60d step, USD 10y10y/20y10y, walk-forward 3y PCA, 1y-fwd 2-7-30 fly at PCA-solved weights): occupancy(carry>=0) pure flattener 12.7% vs manufactured package 39.2% - the fly TRIPLES grail occupancy; median flattener roll -$499/d vs fly +$384/d (covers ~77% of median bleed); median residual/target PCA norm 0.19 (removes 81% of 3-PC metric risk - NOTE this does not contradict H9, which tested a different metric/grid on GS data as a factor HEDGE; H14 is the carry-ENGINE claim). Full 5d-step run launched. The 31y-wing 2-7-30 prices on Citi curves (collision 1 stale).

CRITICAL FIDELITY GAP: 2020-01-15 ING repro FAILS - our time-series-PC1 residual is not their fair-value construction (their frontier R2 0.93 vs ours 0.03 that day; theirs keeps cross-sectional slope structure). A graded F-ING run must first rebuild the residual as a cross-sectional fitted-curve deviation or it tests a strawman. F-ING stays behind SV in the queue.

VALIDATION GATES (L-0009): (a) 2019-05-08 Figure-7 tie-out PASS - spreads match published to -0.8bp median (8/8 pairs), Spearman BE 0.958, spread rank 0.976, carry sign 7/8. (c) GS-vs-Citi 2017-2026 PASS - 2,470 overlap days, spread basis median -0.2bp, p95 2.7bp, rolling-63d-median range 4.4bp (<15 required). (b) 2023-06-08 FAIL on the pre-registered +/-3bp carry tolerance - ROOT-CAUSED: spread matches EXACTLY (-51.5 vs -51.5) but our roll convention is ~0.5x Citi's; the BE gap is EXACTLY sqrt(carry gap) (carry ratio 0.503 -> sqrt 0.709 vs measured BE ratio 0.715), so ONE scale factor k~0.5 on roll explains carry (k), BE (sqrt k) and BE/RV on both anchor dates. Alternative carry definitions measured: PV-roll 1y -3.93, spread-slide -4.29 vs published -6.89 (steepener +): all sign-consistent. VERDICT: pre-2024 Citi data VALIDATED (a+c+exact spread); the carry-scale is a cross-quoting caveat only - internal states (carry>=0, BE/RV ordering) are sign/order-invariant to k>0. Open question parked: what k is (accrual component? financing?).

H16 oracle gate PREVIEW (deduped panel, 2% ghost contamination - graded rerun on clean rebuild): basis = BE(pair) - IV(locus) bp/day, 2020-01..2026-08, ~2,680d. Basis medians -1.0..-3.1 (embedded BE cheap vs traded, as the framework says). On |z|>=1.5 fire days (17-24%): perfect-direction basis capture median 0.25-0.56 bp/day at 21bd, 0.42-0.79 at 63bd (p75 to 1.4); linear-leg RT in basis units 0.26-0.43 bp/day + swaption leg ~0.03-0.12 (CM-1 pending) -> pond/boat ~0.8-1.8x, best on 15y5y/20y10y. THIN: an oracle is the ceiling and typical harvest is ~10-30% of it -> z-fade H16 likely dies at 1x costs. NOT measured by this oracle: the carry-collection component (both legs collect when realized lands between BE and implied) - the graded H16 measures it; expectations calibrated LOW.

L-0017 RESTATED (advisor): the sqrt-k match is not independent evidence of one convention factor - BE = sqrt(2|roll|/Gamma) makes BE_ratio = sqrt(roll_ratio) WHENEVER the Gammas agree. The sharp claim: our GAMMA matches Citi's (the convexity engine is validated); only the ROLL convention differs (~2x, unresolved - and the spread-slide test was sign-INCONSISTENT with the published 2019 carry, so the convention family is NOT identified; parked). CHECKER CALIBRATION PASSED (charter requirement): a fresh checker agent given a fabricated ALIVE-pending memo containing the planted carry-tautological placebo KILLED it on three independent grounds: (1) the planted defect, named precisely ('the state is a function of the same curves that generate the P&L; p=0.002 appears with the hypothesis false'); (2) an arithmetic impossibility in the fabricated numbers (control net forced >= +376bp vs printed +38.2 - caught fabrication by pure arithmetic); (3) pre-registration deviation (carry-only vs registered carry AND gamma - the REAL detector complies: grail_flattener = pos_gamma & roll>=0). Its 13-row output is adopted as the real H13/H16b grading checklist: DSR at 3,888+N, median across arms, NW t + non-overlapping Sharpe, largest-episode %, 2022 concentration, steepener mirror on complement state, single-leg shadow on the same state, ex-carry + sibling-pair-state placebos, exit-lag statement, ghost-filter statement, in-session QDB sign test citation, cold repro.

H13 GRADED VERDICT: DEAD at the registered spec (SELECTION-ARTIFACT on the positive arms per stats.py semantics). 14 of 17 arms graded (EUR 3 pending, cannot change the verdict - DSR is 0.000 everywhere at n_trials=3,905 = N_sv 3,888 + 17): best arm USD 15y5y/20y10y +106.7bp net@1x over 116 episodes (+0.92/trade, hit 37%, t 1.70, NW t 1.23, biggest-episode 37% of net, skew +0.28, maxDD -67bp) - DSR 0.000; median across arms ~+0.0bp; GBP arms -816/-517 (churn kill, L-0027); JPY gate-dead. Conditional does not beat always-on on total net. Full numbers h13_grade.parquet. trials_delta 17.

PRE-REGISTERED (before its numbers): H14-graded = the manufactured package AS A HOLD (Peter's actual practice, and what H13's churn autopsy points to): ALWAYS-ON USD 10y10y/20y10y flattener + received 1y-fwd 2-7-30 fly at walk-forward PCA-solved weights, fly re-solved at each 25bp resize trigger and each annual roll, PER-LEG costs on every fly trade (decomposition.initiate_cost_usd semantics: 3 legs x half-spread x traded DV01) + the package schedule on the flattener; 2005-2026 on ghost-filtered curves. F1 surface-residual gate (ATM 17x9, 2015-10+, walk-forward rate-PC directionality removed per the BofA prior-killer, monthly refits): oracle pond 6-10x boat everywhere, BUT realized median reversion at 21bd on |z|>=1.5 fires is a COIN FLIP in the measured-cost cells (cluster rev_frac_pos 0.455-0.516, rev_med -0.48..+0.27bp). The only coherent positive group is 12Y-20Y EXPIRY cells (rev/boat 1.2-1.9, frac 55-61%) - precisely the dealer-extrapolated corner (BofA: 'only a small subset actively traded, the rest extrapolated') where CM-1 has NO prints and the 0.34bp RT is an extended assumption; the reverting object there is plausibly Citi's marking model, not a price (the fly-vs-vol model-mark mirage shape). VERDICT: F1 residual-fade DEAD AT GATE for measured cells; the long-expiry corner is recorded as a data-quality mirage candidate, NOT a pond. No backtest run; trials_delta 0.

H14-GRADED VERDICT: mechanism CONFIRMED on every registered column; NOT ALIVE at the house bar. 5,395 days, 201 re-solves, 0 errors. Fly gross +40.9bp; maintenance 31.0bp at 1x (per-leg, cost_model half-spreads) -> net contribution +9.9bp at 1x (+25.4 at 0.5x, -21.1 at 2x - flips inside the sensitivity band, stated); SECOND-half concentrated (+14.7 H2 vs -4.8 H1, unlike the flattener itself); post-2017 fly gross +30.4 vs pure +38.1; combined book vol 28.4 vs pure 29.6 bp/yr (risk-REDUCING); gamma retention 92.8-97.4% with belly RECEIVED on all four sample dates (2016/2020/2023/2026) - Peter's construction does what he said: keeps the vega, sheds 81% of factor risk, collects carry. HOUSE VERDICT: net@1x positive but DSR ~0.000 at n=3,910 -> SELECTION-ARTIFACT by the letter, NOT ALIVE. The 2x flip and the sub-0.3 Sharpe scale are honest kills for a certified strategy claim. trials_delta 1 -> 22.

STRUCTURAL OBSERVATION (shapes family selection from here): at the SV family's inherited N~3,900, DSR>0.5 requires a per-period Sharpe far above anything a carry-class always-on book can produce (Citi's own published Sharpes 0.05-0.35; our best 0.28). The realistic ALIVE candidates must have (a) many independent periods and per-period SR >> the deflation benchmark, or (b) live in a family with its OWN small trial count and a genuinely large pond/boat. The loop's next families should weight: intraday constructions on the minute curves (thousands of periods), cross-sectional many-bet books, and event-window trades - not more EOD carry variants.

The V-SV-13 'mechanism survives' wording is WITHDRAWN: what the circular-shift placebo certified is generic spread mean-reversion from steep extremes (long known, cost-bound - the graveyard's oldest resident), NOT a free-convexity-state timing edge. The DEAD verdict is unchanged; the surviving-claim sentence is corrected. H14G's carry-manufacture claim is orthogonal (about the fly covering bleed, not MTM timing) and unaffected.
